style: Premium photorealistic miniature 3D dioramas, silver, porcelain white, blue, teal and warm wood; transparent background; distinct subject per function.

artworks.label: Einstellungen
artworks.subject: General application settings: a sophisticated physical desktop control console with three substantial mechanical sliders, tactile switches, and a visible precision gear assembly. A small angled glass control display and a slim tuning tool emphasize configuring the application. This should look like a believable high-end configuration workstation, with blue indicators, silver controls, warm neutral base. No people, no flag pennants.

artworks.label: Profil
artworks.subject: Personal user profile and account: a realistic miniature personal identity desk display with the framed portrait of ONE friendly adult care professional, a standing personal ID card with portrait but no writing, a smartphone showing a large portrait area and a tiny key. Polished individual-account scene in pale blue and silver. Keep clearly distinct from an employee list or team permissions dashboard; one person only, no group board, no vault.

artworks.label: Support & Hilfe
artworks.subject: Customer support and help: a lifelike miniature helpful support agent wearing a headset, seated at a compact curved desk with a laptop, two clear blue speech-message panels, and a small open troubleshooting notebook. Human-centred service-desk diorama with realistic cloth, face, silver laptop, white and blue desk. No floating question-mark glyph as the main motif. A single agent, no second person.

artworks.label: Feature Flags
artworks.subject: Software feature flags and controlled release: a miniature release-control laboratory with three upright translucent feature cards, substantial individual on/off toggle switches in different positions, two small real fabric flag pennants on short silver poles, green and amber status lights, and a small test-stage platform. The physical flags plus switches must make feature activation recognizable. No people, no generic settings gear as the main motif. No text on cards.

artworks.label: Wohnbereiche
artworks.subject: Residential care areas: an elegant architectural cutaway miniature of one residential care wing, showing several separate accessible rooms connected by a broad corridor and a shared lounge with armchairs, a side table and green plants. Show the relation between distinct rooms and the shared living area clearly, in a cohesive three-dimensional building cross-section. Calm blue and warm wood interior, no labels, no people. This is a whole care wing, not a single bedroom.

artworks.label: Zimmer
artworks.subject: Individual resident room in a care home: one complete accessible bedroom cutaway, with ONE neatly made height-adjustable care bed in pale teal bedding, a bedside cabinet and reading lamp, an upholstered armchair, a small wardrobe and a visible nurse-call handset near the bed. Realistic warm wooden floor on a miniature architectural base. Clear personal bedroom setting, distinct from a multi-room building or hospital ward. No people.

artworks.label: Übergabe
artworks.subject: Care shift handover: two realistic miniature nursing professionals at a compact ward handover desk, one passing a single open clinical clipboard to the other while both review it attentively. Add a small desktop clock and an angled tablet with simple colored care-status rows, without writing. Warm human interaction, blue and white workwear, professional care context. Main subject is the transfer between two people, not a pile of reports.

artworks.label: Übergabeberichte
artworks.subject: Written care shift handover reports: a richly detailed open blue leather shift logbook with distinct colored divider tabs, structured chart lines without words, a polished pen, a few neatly clipped handover report sheets, and a propped tablet displaying a structured shift-report grid. Add a small unobtrusive clock. The main subject is clear reviewed written handover documentation. No people. Horizontal open-logbook composition, distinct from a vertical document binder or general notebook.
